data.summary: Business Analyst / Functional Consultant with 8.6 years of experience in Banking and Financial Services, including 6 years of dedicated Business Analysis experience. Strong domain expertise in Trade Finance, Core Banking and Digital Banking, with hands-on experience across Letter of Credit (LC), Import Finance, Export Finance, Import & Export Bills, Bank Guarantee (BG), Foreign Remittances, FDI and ODI. Analysed and documented Treasury, Credit, Market, Liquidity Risk, and AML requirements, covering risk exposure, liquidity positions, transaction monitoring, controls, and regulatory reporting. Collaborated with Treasury, Risk, AML/Compliance, Finance, Operations, and Technology stakeholders to define requirements, workflows, functional specifications, and process improvements. Experienced in Agile/Scrum and Waterfall delivery, requirements elicitation and analysis, BRD/FRD/SRS, user stories, acceptance criteria, process mapping, gap and impact analysis, stakeholder management, UAT and production validation. Developed comprehensive project documentation, including requirement specifications, design documents, and test plans, to ensure clarity and alignment among stakeholders and project teams. Ensuring clear, sequential progression through requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment phases. Worked closely with product owners and stakeholders to prioritize and manage product backlogs, ensuring that the most valuable features are delivered first and aligned with business objectives.
